rationale: In the European morning there is little new US information and the NQ book is thin, so a 5-minute close two or more sigmas away from the London-session VWAP is mostly one impatient order, liquidity providers lean against it and price comes back toward the average before New York. Losing side: The impatient overnight order and the momentum traders who chase a stretch in a thin book.
